audit.whatIsWrong: Row 4 (Level 6) was given to Quinn in both layers while the packet chart reads Ornn and the page's own whys[4] says the all-in 'is lethal' for Ornn.
audit.why: At 59.87% over 755 games this is Ornn's best matchup in the slice, and level 6 is where Call of the Forge God arrives against a champion whose only escape is a 12s dash. Behind Enemy Lines is a roaming tool, not a duelling spike.
audit.corrected: Row 4 Quinn -> Ornn (3/10 -> 6/10) in BOTH layers as a matched pair. Rows 0-3, 5, 6 already matched the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said only 'Quinn: Vault online, level 6, first item' without naming Behind Enemy Lines or saying what level 6 actually gives her.
audit.why: Behind Enemy Lines does not make her stronger in a duel — it makes her leave. Framing level 6 as a roam spike tells the player to track her rather than to fear the 1v1.
audit.corrected: Spikes now read: Quinn — Vault online, Behind Enemy Lines at 6 for roams, first item. Ornn — level 3 for Bellows Breath, Iceborn Gauntlet, 2 items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors repeated across the page. (1) The blind was attributed to Vault — 'E vault-blind', 'Save E vault to blind your auto', 'Fight into her blind' under the Vault heading. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q), 1025 range, 11s at rank 1: 'calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision'. Vault contains no blind at all. (2) Vault was called a knockback — 'knock you back out of your E-Q combo range', 'her knockback dash'. Riot's text: 'she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.' SHE moves, not you; what you get is a brief interrupt.
audit.why: A player who believes Vault blinds will hold their autos at the wrong moment and eat the real blind from 1025 range. A player who believes Vault knocks them back will misjudge where they end up after her dash — in truth they stay put, interrupted, while she is suddenly an attack range away. Also unstated: Heightened Senses (50s at rank 1) is where her chase speed comes from, granted after she attacks a Harrier target; and Behind Enemy Lines is a channel that any CC ends before Skystrike fires.
audit.corrected: Blind re-attributed to Blinding Assault with its 1025 range; Vault restated as a 675-range, 12s interrupt that repositions HER; Heightened Senses named as the speed source; the channel cancel added.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried 'Her self-peel' with no numbers and a placeholder committal-tool line.
audit.why: Vault at 12s rank 1 falling to 8s is the entire window structure of this lane, and Blinding Assault's 1025 range versus Ornn's 800 explains why a poke war is unwinnable.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now gives Vault 675/12s with the correct displacement direction and Blinding Assault 1025/11s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad, and dontsFull[0].d used 'his win condition' about Quinn.
audit.why: 'Fight into her blind' and 'Poke-war from range' both carried template text that never explained the range mismatch.
audit.corrected: Each rule now carries its own fact: the blind's real slot and range, the 1025-versus-800 poke mismatch, and Heightened Senses' speed.

notes: Two errors here would change how the player behaves. (1) The blind was on the wrong ability in four strings — it is Blinding Assault (Q) at 1025 range, and Vault has no blind whatsoever. (2) Vault was described as knocking Ornn back; Riot's text says Quinn 'leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away' — the displacement is hers, the player only gets interrupted. The 1025-vs-800 range gap is now stated, which is the real reason a poke war loses. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED: Behind Enemy Lines' true cooldown — the kit file lists '3', which is the recast/deactivate timer, not the ability's real cooldown, so I gave no number for it anywhere. Also not asserted: whether Bellows Breath specifically cancels the channel (the missing-interactions file claims it does, but Brittle is not described as crowd control in Riot's text, so I wrote 'any CC from you'), and whether Vault's brief interrupt can cancel Searing Charge mid-dash.
